finding.claim: This change left orphans and stale comments. _apm_run has no caller now that patch never runs APM. The comment on HARNESSES says '--harness accepts', and the one on DEFAULT_SOURCE says 'unless --source names another'. Neither option exists any more.

fixes.change: read_json's "not valid JSON" fix says to run the command again; the dead _apm_run is gone; the HARNESSES, APM_CLI and DEFAULT_SOURCE comments no longer name --harness or --source; unpatch reports the scope it was given.
kmctl plugin patch --undo passes its --scope through, so --json reports it.
